name: Visa de Migrante (M) -- Vínculo Familiar con Nacional Colombiano

requirements.blocker_text: Requires being the spouse, permanent partner (companero/a permanente), or parent/adoptive parent of a Colombian national.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate, proof of permanent partnership, or birth/adoption certificate establishing the tie to the Colombian national

sources.title: Cancillería de Colombia -- Visa de Migrante (tipo M): 14 sub-categories listed including spouse/permanent-partner/parent of Colombian national, 3-year validity, 180-day absence rule

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Colombia's initial build. Confirmed at tier-1 that this is a distinct sub-category of the Migrant (M) visa. Migrant M visa holders get an 'open work permit' per the tier-1 source describing the broader M/R visa system, hence work_rights 'full'. pr_after_months (24) and citizenship_after_months (24) reflect the REDUCED tracks that apply specifically to spouses/permanent-partners of Colombian nationals: 2 years of M-visa holding for co_resident_by_accumulated_time's spouse/parent group, and separately 2 years of domicile for co_naturalisation's marriage-based group -- these two 2-year counts are not confirmed to be the same clock or stackable, flagged rather than assumed identical. Mercosur migrant and Andean migrant are two further distinct M sub-categories (regional-integration-agreement based) also confirmed to exist at tier-1 but not modelled as their own route files in this pass due to limited region-specific detail retrieved.
